metric_formula: FP-aware lesion-wise Dice = sum positive-overlap Hungarian matched component Dice / (TP + FN + FP), after filtering GT and prediction components <10 voxels. Absent cases use FP burden: pred volume, pred<10 vox absent-call, pred>10000 flood.
comparison_framing: Spatial priors target FP restraint: compare against the best absent-case FP baseline without regressing detection. Topological priors target detection: compare against the best per-stratum detection baseline without worsening FP.
